label: Obtaining contingent situation and…: A5 describes a contingent situation as a possible situation…
term: obtaining contingent situation and possible situation-cause in A5
definition: A5 describes a contingent situation as a possible situation that need not obtain; obtains means actual. Coverage selects situations obtaining in the chosen W, not all individuals or all possible situations jointly. Its situation-cause title describes a prior condition capable of explaining or partly explaining why that SAME situation obtains. The source does not thereby identify situations with individual beings, fact-reasons with concrete causes, or possible causal availability with actual causation.
note: No particular empirical concrete cause-bearer is supplied. The partial explanatory wording supplies no complete sufficient explanation, temporal-existence guard, structural causal law or independent applicability warrant. A negative situation may obtain even when no contingent individual does; fact admission and actual-concrete causal interpretation remain open.
